item.title: 4 Killed in Oro landslide amid Tropical Storm Basyang
item.description: Four people were killed after a landslide struck Zone 1, Barangay Sambulawan, Barangay Agusan here during the onslaught of Tropical Storm Basyang, authorities confirmed. The landslide occurred at around 10:30 p.m. following hours of continuous heavy rainfall.
